# Add Elements to List

#### Course: Learn C++ STL

## Add Elements to List

We can add elements to a list using the following functions:

- push_back() - inserts an element to the back of the list
- push_front() - inserts an element to the front of the list

```cpp
1#include <iostream>
2#include <list>
3using namespace std;
4
5int main() {
6
7    // Create a list
8    list<string> movies { "The Hangover"};
9
10    // Add an element to the back of the list
11    movies.push_back("Titanic");
12
13    // Add an element to the front of the list
14    movies.push_front("Forest Gump");
15
16    // Print the list elements
17    for (string var: movies) {
18        cout << var << endl;
19    }
20
21    return 0;
22}
```

Output

```text
Forrest Gump
The Hangover
Titanic
```

Now, let's see how the above program actually stores the elements.
